entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair Nnr
observations: Sequence of 485 aa matches reviewed bacterial Nnr proteins over 87–99% query coverage, at 32.9–36.2% identity; assignment is limited homology support.
Nnr is annotated as bifunctional: epimerizes (6R)-NAD(P)HX to (6S)-NAD(P)HX and dehydrates (6S)-NAD(P)HX to NAD(P)H plus phosphate, coupled to ADP-to-AMP conversion.
Reference proteins bind one K+ per subunit; EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136 are annotated.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair reactions
observations: Epimerization: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX; analogous NADPHX epimerization is annotated (Rhea RHEA:32215 and RHEA:32227).
Dehydration/repair: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H+; analogous NADPHX reaction is annotated (Rhea RHEA:32223 and RHEA:32235).
